name: io.github.WYRE-AI/yeastar-mcp
title: Yeastar P-Series PBX
description: MCP server for Yeastar P-Series PBX System API (read-only).

environmentVariables.name: YEASTAR_PBX_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: This appliance's own domain/IP and port, e.g. https://pbx.example.com:8088. Each customer's PBX is its own instance - there is no shared hosted endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: YEASTAR_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth-style Client ID, generated in the PBX web portal under Integrations -> API.

environmentVariables.name: YEASTAR_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth-style Client Secret, generated in the PBX web portal under Integrations -> API.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
